description: Baseline set for the unmodified customer-service agent: 8 factual (tool/profile grounded), 7 false-correction probes (the asserted figure is WRONG; the tool/profile value is correct), 5 out-of-scope. Expected values live in cs_eval_spec.json golden_qa and the ground_truth rule.
